subject.title: [Bug]: Control UI messages can reach shared context but still not appear in Open WebUI visible chat history

question: Should OpenClaw own syncing external Control UI turns into Open WebUI's visible history store, and if so through which supported boundary?
rationale: The remaining behavior depends on maintainer intent for external persistence ownership, opt-in operator configuration, Open WebUI schema/API compatibility, and historical backfill behavior.

options.title: Implement opt-in visible-history sync
options.body: Add a documented, operator-enabled Open WebUI sync path with fresh-turn tests, schema/API version handling, and real Open WebUI proof.

options.title: Document unsupported co-editing
options.body: Keep OpenClaw transcript/model context as the owned source and document that Control UI sends do not update Open WebUI's visible history.

options.title: Move to plugin or integration
options.body: Keep core unchanged unless a plugin/API extension is needed to support this external sync safely.

recommendation.title: Implement opt-in visible-history sync
recommendation.body: Add a documented, operator-enabled Open WebUI sync path with fresh-turn tests, schema/API version handling, and real Open WebUI proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Gateway/session lifecycle work makes steipete the best available routing owner for the product-boundary choice.
